subject: hm-audio-commands-2
description: audio-sdk's edit commands on a multitrack plan (docs/formats/hm-audio-plan.md, docs/adr/0006). input.plan is an hm-audio-plan document of version 2 and input.command an hm-audio-command of version 2; expected is the resulting document, or the rejection. Applying the command's inverse must restore the plan, but the inverse itself is internal. Generated cases come from the reducer's property-test generators, with a fixed seed.
